sheets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create a NEW landscape 3:2 game-item concept art board for a Chinese hand-painted prison factory escape game. The attached image is ONLY a STYLE REFERENCE: match the drawn bun, cloth and bandage item artwork and ivory canvas / muted teal steel UI materials. Do not recreate the screenshot or its UI. This is one of a coordinated series of three item art sheets.
Title at top, exact Chinese: "道具概念 · 生活与社交". Small subtitle: "食物 / 礼物 / 医疗".
Layout: six spacious individual hero icon studies, three columns by two rows, on a quiet smooth warm ivory background with fine graphite dividers and a subtle desaturated teal metal perimeter. Large clean isolated painted objects, dark fine ink contours, simplified readable silhouettes, soft warm overhead-left highlights and minimal soft contact shadows. Slight elevated three-quarter view, consistent angle and lighting, enough volume but illustrative 2D, not photoreal photographs. Crisp edges and smooth painted shading, controlled wear, no grain or excessive rough noisy texture. Earthy muted colours with small red or teal accents, same material language as reference.
The SIX objects, top row left-to-right then bottom row:
1. "饼干" : modest faded ochre paper cracker packet torn slightly open with two square crackers visible.
2. "肉罐头" : squat round tinned meat can, dull metal rim, faded cream and brick-red paper label with a simple generic food illustration, no brand.
3. "速溶咖啡" : small squat brown coffee tin, worn muted teal label, unmistakable cup illustration, no brand.
4. "香烟" : simple cream and brick-red cigarette pack with two cigarette tips visible, no commercial logo.
5. "止痛药" : a silver blister strip holding six white tablets, a restrained generic red medical cross.
6. "消毒药水" : small amber glass antiseptic bottle with cream label and dark screw cap, generic medical marking.
One clear short Chinese name below each object, smaller "1×1 格" below the name. Objects should fill most of their study area but never touch dividers.
Along the bottom a distinct narrow section labeled "背包格子预览": exactly six small equal stitched ivory canvas slots in one horizontal row, each containing a smaller repeat of the six icons IN THE SAME ORDER. This preview is critical: silhouettes must stay recognisable at inventory scale. The bottom previews should have a grey-blue canvas lip and fine stitched outlines similar to reference but no huge backpack bag. Small amber selection outline on the medicine slot only.
No characters, gameplay screenshot, hands, neon, modern military shooter HUD, 3D render, excessive grunge, watermarks, long explanatory paragraphs or extra items. All typography is legible correct Chinese.

Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a NEW landscape 3:2 item concept art board for a Chinese hand-painted prison factory escape game. Reference image 1 is the approved existing inventory UI, used ONLY for materials and style. Reference image 2 is the companion life-item concept board: MATCH its exact illustration treatment, light warm ivory study background, quiet thin graphite separators, outer muted teal metal rim, cream title placard with rivets, typography hierarchy, crisp dark contours, slight elevated three-quarter view and upper-left lighting. Do not reproduce the screenshot. This is a cohesive series of NEW item art sheets. Large isolated hero icons in a three-column two-row study layout with short Chinese names and small footprint captions under each item. Earthy faded colours, nuanced but clean hand-painted 2D shading, strong silhouettes, controlled wear, soft contact shadows, crisp details useful for small inventory icons, no photographic rendering, no heavy grain or noisy distressed texture. Bottom quarter of the image is a shallow ivory canvas inventory strip with grey-blue fabric lip, stitched slot outlines, title "背包格子预览". It shows SMALL repeats of the SAME six objects, at their different grid sizes, with a few clearly empty cells; never reshape the inventory slots around the items, each multi-slot item spans full standard rectangular cells. No people, hands, HUD screenshot, neon, guns, photorealism, watermark or long paragraphs. All Chinese text is correctly spelled and readable.
Exact title "道具概念 · 工具与制作". Subtitle "材料 / 工具 / 装备".
SIX hero objects, top row left-to-right then bottom row:
1 "胶带", caption "1×1 格": thick dull grey adhesive tape roll lying at a slight angle so the cardboard core is visible, one short curled tape end.
2 "螺丝盒", caption "1×1 格": small open faded olive metal tin containing a few clearly legible screws and nuts, simplified strong silhouette, no tiny confetti details.
3 "工作手套", caption "2×1 格": a pair of worn tan leather work gloves with grey-blue fabric cuffs, loosely stacked horizontally, visible distinct fingers.
4 "钳子", caption "1×2 格": upright long ordinary steel pliers, old muted rust-red rubber handles, jaws pointing up, clear two-pronged silhouette, no brands.
5 "维修包", caption "2×2 格": compact square olive canvas tool pouch, flap slightly open showing just a steel tool handle and small stitched repair patch; distinguish from gloves and from the extension bag.
6 "帆布扩容袋", caption "2×2 格": compact folded cream canvas satchel with grey-blue roll-top edge, a short strap and brass fastening; a plain bag, not a military rucksack, strong recognisable bag outline.
Bottom inventory preview exactly SIX COLUMNS and THREE ROWS of equal square slots, 18 slots, coherent occupied footprints: gloves span row 1 columns 1-2; tape row 1 column 3; screw tin row 1 column 4; repair pouch spans rows 1-2 columns 5-6; pliers span rows 2-3 column 1; extension bag spans rows 2-3 columns 2-3; leave the remaining cells empty. These are flat icons laid OVER the grid, not physically placed objects in cubbies. Fine amber selection outline around the whole 1×2 pliers footprint. Prioritize clean material separation and the larger tool silhouettes.

2 "送货单", caption "2×1 格": a folded horizontally oriented ochre delivery form with large simple parcel mark, dull red circular stamp and slightly curled corner. Only heading "送货单". Shape, hue and marking distinct from the roster.

Duty roster spans row 1 columns 1-2; delivery form spans row 1 columns 3-4; employee card at row 1 column 5; secret note at row 1 column 6. Folded work clothes span rows 2-3 columns 1-2; temporary pass at row 2 column 3; remaining cells empty. Small flat icons overlaid across normal grid cells, not objects sitting in physical compartments. Fine amber selection rectangle around the full 2×1 duty roster. Show distinct paper folds and document silhouettes so they remain recognisable in the tiny inventory previews.

notes: Eighteen new item proposals. Inventory strips illustrate icon legibility; definitive footprints are set during asset production.
